evals.name: triggers-on-mz-hit-spark
evals.prompt: a pixel-art hit spark for RPG Maker, a short impact burst
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:vfx. Reads the MV-style img/animations layout in engine-layouts.md (not Effekseer). Writes brief.md before the first render, authors the burst as palette steps, renders a sheet and GIF with render.py, and reviews motion from preview.png.
expectations: Uses the MV-style animation cell sheet from engine-layouts.md
Does not write an Effekseer .efkefc file
Writes brief.md and grades each done criterion pass or fail
Reviews motion from the sheet, not from a GIF's first frame alone

evals.name: near-miss-walk-cycle-routes-to-animate
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:vfx. A character walk cycle is /pixel-art:animate.
expectations: Does not invoke the vfx skill for a walk cycle

evals.name: near-miss-effekseer-file
evals.prompt: export an Effekseer .efkefc explosion for MZ
evals.expected_output: Does not write an .efkefc file. Says MZ's native effect format is outside this plugin and offers the MV-style pixel cell sheet instead.
expectations: Names the pixel cell sheet as the asset this skill can deliver
